+    def delete_identity_pool(self, identity_pool_id: str) -> None:
+        """
+        Delete an identity pool by ID
+        """
+        if identity_pool_id not in self.identity_pools:
+            raise ResourceNotFoundError(identity_pool_id)
+            
+        # Remove the identity pool
+        del self.identity_pools[identity_pool_id]
+        
+        # Also remove any associated identities
+        if identity_pool_id in self.pools_identities:
+            del self.pools_identities[identity_pool_id]
+            
+        return ""
